activity_statements.statement: advises global business leaders and private equity investors on strategy, change management, and industry-defining challenges, operating across 67 cities in 40 countries
serves private equity firms and their portfolio companies on investment diligence, value creation, and exit strategy
has worked with more than two-thirds of the Global 500 and 9,000+ companies worldwide since its 1973 founding
provides consulting recognized as a leader in digital business, innovation, strategy, experience design, customer experience, and carbon-zero transformation
fields a 19,000-person workforce combining strategists, industry/functional experts, technologists, and advisors across a global integrated team
delivers pro bono management consulting to nonprofit and public-sector organizations, pledging $2B of pro bono work by 2035

name_reality_gap: Index label 'Consulting Finance & Insurance' implies financial-sector-specific work; Bain is a general management consulting firm serving all industries globally, with private equity being a prominent practice but not the sole or majority client base.
extraction_notes: About page provided good content on firm size, history, and positioning. No detailed practice area revenue split available (private company).
